new.name: JUDGES_PRIOR_RESULT_INCONCLUSIVE
new.definition: The reasoning assesses a prior observation as insufficient or ambiguous for establishing the targeted state because the result is empty, errored, or does not distinguish between possible conditions.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that evaluates the prior observation as inconclusive.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The prior observation whose result is judged insufficient or ambiguous.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to an earlier observation and characterizes its content as empty, ambiguous, failed, or otherwise unable to confirm the target state.
The reasoning explains why the result does not settle the question or why a different check is needed.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats the prior observation as definitive confirmation or disconfirmation.
The reasoning does not refer to a prior observation.
The observation is unrelated to the targeted state.

new.name: REVISES_BELIEF_WITH_NEW_EVIDENCE
new.definition: The reasoning explicitly corrects or updates an earlier belief, interpretation, or hypothesis using identifiable new evidence from the observation.

parameters.name: revision_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text that states the revised belief or interpretation.

parameters.name: evidence_observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying the new evidence that motivates the revision.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to a prior belief, hypothesis, or provisional interpretation.
The reasoning changes or corrects that belief in response to identifiable content in the observation.
The reasoning makes clear what the revised belief is.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without referencing a prior belief.
The observation is unrelated to the belief being revised.
No prior belief or provisional interpretation is identifiable.

new.name: CHECKS_REQUIREMENTS_AGAINST_OBSERVED_STATE
new.definition: The reasoning enumerates multiple requirements or deliverables and uses the observations collectively as evidence to determine whether each is satisfied.

parameters.name: requirement_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that enumerates requirements or deliverables and assesses them against observed facts.

parameters.name: evidence_observations
parameters.description: The observations that collectively supply facts corresponding to the enumerated requirements.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies or enumerates multiple distinct requirements or deliverables.
The evidence observations collectively contain facts corresponding to those requirements.
The reasoning maps or assesses the observed facts against the requirements rather than merely restating the task.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning lists requirements without relating them to observed evidence.
The observations do not contain facts addressing the enumerated requirements.
Only a single requirement is considered, so no multi-requirement check is present.

new.name: DISAMBIGUATES_FALSE_POSITIVE_MATCH
new.definition: The reasoning explains that an apparent match or candidate in an observation does not satisfy the intended target condition because it arises from incidental, contextual, or unrelated content, and distinguishes it from a genuine match.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that explains why the apparent match is a false positive.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the apparent match or candidate.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains at least one apparent candidate match for a sought condition.
The reasoning explains why that match is a false positive, citing incidental or unrelated content.
The reasoning distinguishes the false positive from a genuine match or concludes that no genuine match exists among those candidates.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning accepts the apparent match as genuine without explanation.
The reasoning does not identify any apparent match in the observation.
The reasoning only states that no match is present without explaining why a candidate was misleading.

new.name: DECLARES_TASK_COMPLETION
new.definition: The reasoning concludes that all specified requirements have been satisfied and that no further action is required.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text declaring completion or full verification.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that the task or all specified requirements are complete or verified.
The reasoning indicates that no further action remains.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only summarizes progress while identifying remaining work.
The reasoning remains uncertain about completion or plans further checks.

uncertain.name: IS_VERIFICATION_PLAN
uncertain.definition: The reasoning explicitly outlines one or more checks intended to confirm that a state, behavior, or deliverable satisfies requirements.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text expressing an intended verification plan.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one future check or test intended to confirm a state, behavior, or deliverable.
The reasoning makes clear what is to be verified rather than only stating an implementation action.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports completed checks or results.
The reasoning only describes implementation work without expressing an intention to verify an outcome.

uncertain.name: PROPOSES_CAUSAL_EXPLANATION_FOR_ANOMALY
uncertain.definition: The reasoning offers a causal account of why an observed result or system state is unexpected, missing, erroneous, or inconsistent.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text that explains an unexpected, missing, or inconsistent result.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific anomaly, such as an empty result, absent process, failed command, or unexpected output.
The reasoning offers at least one causal mechanism or explanatory condition for that anomaly rather than only reporting or repeating it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely restates an observation without explaining why it occurred.
The reasoning only states a future action or plan.
No anomaly or discrepancy is identified.

uncertain.name: PERFORMS_ALTERNATIVE_METHOD_AFTER_TOOL_FAILURE
uncertain.definition: After an observation reports that an intended command, tool, or resource is unavailable or unsuccessful, the reasoning selects and the action performs a functionally different method to accomplish the intended verification or operation.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the originally intended command, tool, or resource is unavailable or has failed.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that acknowledges the failure and selects an alternative method.

parameters.name: alternative_action
parameters.description: The action performing the alternative method instead of repeating the failed operation.

assertion_conditions: The failure observation reports that an intended command, tool, or resource is unavailable or unsuccessful.
The reasoning explicitly acknowledges the unavailability or failure and identifies an alternative method.
The action performs the alternative method rather than repeating the failed operation.
exclusion_conditions: The action simply retries the same failed command or tool.
The reasoning does not acknowledge the failure or does not connect the action to an alternative.
The observation does not report an unavailable or failed tool, command, or resource.

uncertain.name: VERIFIES_BEHAVIOR_WITH_EXECUTED_TEST
uncertain.definition: The reasoning specifies expected behavior or acceptance conditions, the action executes a test designed to exercise them, and the observation reports actual outcomes that can be compared with those expectations.

parameters.name: expectation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying expected behaviors or acceptance conditions.

parameters.name: test_action
parameters.description: The action executing the test or probe that exercises those behaviors.

parameters.name: test_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting actual test outcomes relevant to the expectations.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning articulates expected behaviors, outputs, or acceptance conditions for the system under test.
The action executes a test or probe that exercises those behaviors.
The observation reports actual outcomes sufficient to compare against the stated expectations, including an overall pass/fail or equivalent result.
exclusion_conditions: The test is executed without any stated expected behavior or acceptance condition.
The action does not exercise the behaviors described in the reasoning.
The observation does not report outcomes relevant to those expectations.
